  • Develop as a leader, join Delivery Management, Resource Management, Leadership Essentials school and more
  • Participate in internal communities (500+ meetups, technical discussions, brainstorming sessions, online events and conferences annually)

What we offer:

  • Vacation and sick leave (including a sick leave without a medical certificate)
  • A wide range of Voluntary Medical Insurance programs providing both medical treatment and various preventive options (including sports activities)
  • Medical insurance for family members at corporate rates
  • Company support during significant life events (childbirth or adoption, marriage, etc.)

Are you ready to elevate your Python engineering skills and transition into the exciting field of Big Data? EPAM is offering a unique opportunity where you can secure a position after a single technical interview and gain Big Data expertise without affecting your title or compensation.

This 8-week retraining program is designed to transition Python engineers into the role of Big Data engineer. EPAM Advisory is where pharma strategy meets real engineering execution. We work with global pharmaceutical and biopharma companies on some of their most important technology challenges. Our work covers using AI to speed up drug discovery, building compliant cloud infrastructure for R&D, creating agentic workflows for clinical teams and designing the commercial platforms that bring new therapies to patients.

What makes us different is the bridge between strategy and delivery. Our consultants work alongside EPAM engineers, data scientists and AI specialists. Recommendations become working platforms, real data pipelines and measurable outcomes, not slide decks.

Germany and Switzerland are strategic priorities for EPAM. They sit at the heart of European pharma, and that is where we are investing now. You will have direct access to senior leadership and early commercial responsibility. You will also have the opportunity to shape client outcomes and the growth of our life sciences and healthcare practice across Europe, backed by the scale, AI capabilities and engineering excellence of a global technology leader.

As Director, you will own senior pharma client relationships, typically at CTO, CDO, CMO or CSO level. You will lead large or multiple concurrent engagements and turn complex scientific, regulatory and technology challenges into compelling proposals and measurable outcomes. You will be a recognized voice with clients and in the market, and you will play a direct role in growing our people and our practice.

  • По инструментам не ограничиваем, ресурсы выделяем быстро, весь AWS в нашем распоряжении;

  • развиваем self-service и аналитические продукты для потребителей данных, аналитиков разгружаем от рутины.
